tasks.description: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). This is a crucial step to ensure the banana bread is cooked properly. The oven should be preheated before any other steps are taken.
acceptance_criteria: Given the oven is preheated, when a thermometer is inserted, then the temperature reads 350°F (175°C).

tasks.description: Grease a 9x5 loaf pan to prevent the banana bread from sticking. This step should be done after the oven is preheated.
acceptance_criteria: Given the loaf pan is greased, when a small amount of water is poured into it, then the water does not stick to the pan.

tasks.description: Mash 3 ripe bananas with a fork until smooth. This step is essential for the banana bread's flavor and texture.
acceptance_criteria: Given the bananas are mashed, when a spoon is inserted, then the bananas are smooth and there are no lumps.

tasks.description: Stir the melted butter into the mashed bananas. This step combines the flavors and textures of the bananas and butter.
acceptance_criteria: Given the butter and bananas are mixed, when a spoon is inserted, then the mixture is smooth and well combined.

tasks.description: Mix in the baking soda and salt. These ingredients are essential for the banana bread's flavor and texture.
acceptance_criteria: Given the baking soda and salt are added, when the mixture is tasted, then the flavors are balanced.

tasks.description: Stir in the sugar, beaten egg, and vanilla extract. These ingredients add flavor and texture to the banana bread.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sugar, egg, and vanilla are mixed, when a spoon is inserted, then the mixture is smooth and well combined.

tasks.description: Fold in the flour until just combined — do not overmix. This step is crucial for the banana bread's texture.
acceptance_criteria: Given the flour is folded in, when the mixture is observed, then the flour is just combined and not overmixed.

tasks.description: Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan. This step is essential for the banana bread's shape and texture.
acceptance_criteria: Given the batter is poured into the loaf pan, when the pan is observed, then the batter is evenly distributed and the pan is filled to the correct level.

tasks.description: Bake for 50 to 60 minutes, until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. This step is crucial for the banana bread's texture and flavor.
acceptance_criteria: Given the banana bread is baked, when a toothpick is inserted into the center, then the toothpick comes out clean.
